decisions.label: UNDERSTATED
decisions.rationale: T1.r5 exceeds T1.r3 on Yelp, SpamAssassin, and LUN; limiting Method M+’s larger radius to LUN understates its established advantage.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T2 defines smaller Wasserstein distance as better adaptation to input length. Thus Method M+’s smallest distances—on Yelp and LUN—support this interpretation, despite not being smallest on SpamAssassin.

decisions.label: UNDERSTATED
decisions.rationale: T1.r5 has higher mean CR than T1.r2 on all three datasets, so saying Method M+ was larger only on LUN understates the supported scope.

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1 reports 2.77 versus 2.35 but provides no criterion or statistical test establishing that this difference constitutes near-parity.

decisions.label: UNDERSTATED
decisions.rationale: Method M+ exceeds RanMASK on both Yelp (6.78 versus 0.00) and LUN (66.90 versus 34.51), so restricting improvement to LUN understates the evidence.
